The '''battle of the Rood''' was an engagement that [[Klyn Shanga]] and his longtime friend and companion, Colonel [[Kenow]] had fought in as boys. The battle was considered an insignificant part of a much larger conflict, but to the two young soldiers, it was a life-altering event.<ref name="oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
